name: @javis-dog/jgr-sdk
description: JGR client SDK. S3b: event builder (monotonic ULIDs, per-thread sequence, JD-M01 validation), memory and file spools with oldest-first eviction, batching with gzip, retry with full jitter and Retry-After (ADR-0009). Signing and encryption arrive with JGR v0.2 / JD-M11.
